## ABxAG v1.1.23

### Fixed

- **The app comes back after an automatic update.** A silent (/S) install skips the installer's finish page — and that page was the only thing launching the new build — so the update applied correctly and left you with a closed program and no explanation. The relaunch is now scheduled through the Windows Task Scheduler before quitting, so it runs after the installer has finished. Manual installs still use the wizard, which already restarts the app.
- **The alarm chime no longer depends on the WebAudio device.** On machines where the audio device would not open, the ring was visual only. The chime failure is now handled, and the shell beep takes over as the guaranteed audible alert — three beeps, and the window comes forward when ABxAG was hidden or in the tray.

### Verified

- tsc clean - 121 agent tests (3 new for the update-relaunch path), 8 character, 32 Python
- Against the real Windows Task Scheduler: the helper ran on its own, waited for the installer to exit, and started the app
- Installed (non-portable) builds only: a portable build is never asked to restart itself
- Public build: no bundled character models, users import their own on first run

## ABxAG v1.1.22

### Fixed

- **Alarms are audible now.** A reminder that fired used to be silent unless a live voice session happened to be connected. Every ring now plays a chime and announces itself, and the shell beeps and pulls the window forward even when ABxAG is hidden or sitting in the tray.
- **Alarms work when ABxAG is closed.** Each scheduled alarm is registered with the Windows Task Scheduler, which owns it — so closing the app, a crash, or an update can no longer swallow a reminder. Snoozing, dismissing or cancelling removes the registration, and a reminder that came due while the app was shut still tells you it was missed.
- The ring is no longer published as a notification event that nothing handled.

## ABxAG v1.1.21

### Fixed
- **Alarms, reminders and timers actually work now.** Saying *"set an alarm in 5 minutes"* really schedules one: ABxAG now has a scheduling tool she must call before confirming anything, so she can no longer just *say* it is set. She reports the exact local time back from the scheduler's own result, and if scheduling fails she says so instead of pretending.
- **The reminder ring shows up.** Alarms that fire while ABxAG is closed are caught and shown, marked as missed, instead of being silently dropped.
- **Bad times are refused loudly.** A negative, zero or unparseable time used to be coerced into "one second from now" — which rang immediately and read as a five-minute reminder.
- Repaired the half-finished settings refactor: the alarms panel was left unmounted, so the feature had no UI at all.

### New
- **Settings > System > Alarms & reminders:** add upcoming alarms/reminders/timers (kind, time, label, daily/weekdays repeat), and snooze, dismiss or cancel any of them.
- **Ask her instead:** *"remind me to stretch at 6"*, *"start a 10 minute timer"*, *"what reminders do I have?"*, *"cancel that reminder"*.
- Unacknowledged rings fade on their own after 90 s instead of sitting on screen forever.

### Verified
- tsc clean · 108 agent (9 new alarm-scheduler tests) + 8 character + 32 Python tests green
- Schedules persist across restarts; the runtime keeps them, not the UI
- Public build: no bundled character models, users import their own on first run

## ABxAG v1.1.20

### New
- **Alarm & reminder ring:** When an alarm, reminder or timer fires she now becomes the moment — grows big on your desktop, waves, and a ring card appears (Snooze 5 min / OK, got it). It works even with no voice session connected.
- **Settings > System > Alarms & reminders:** add upcoming alarms/reminders/timers (kind, time, label, daily/weekdays repeat) and cancel any time. Or just ask in chat: *"remind me at 6 in the morning to stretch"*.
- **Boot screen shows the real build version** instead of the frozen v1.1.15 string from an older era.

### Verified
- tsc clean · 99 agent + 8 character + 32 Python tests green · secret scan clean
- Public portable build (no bundled character models; users import their own on first run)

## New
- **Updates now live where you look for them:** Settings > System > **Update** is the first section. Update mode (Auto/Manual), Check, download progress, Install now and version switching all moved there from About.
- Command palette: typing `update` or `upgrade` now jumps to Settings: System.

## Fixed
- Nothing broken: move-only change — updater logic, differential downloads and update modes behave exactly as before. Settings > About keeps the version + links only.

## New — lighter + steadier hands

- **Virtual mouse removed.** Dual-cursor broke reliable working, so it's gone end to end (12 tools, overlay, endpoint, setting, prompt rule). The AI now drives your physical mouse with exact text labels, yields the moment you touch the PC, and risky actions go through confirmations + emergency stop. Frozen agent: 96 -> 84 tools.
- **HUD overlay that works.** The avatar mirror never delivered frames ('no frame yet' forever) — replaced with a self-contained 2D hologram (eyes follow your pointer, mouth moves as she speaks). Conversation falls back to the command log; mic shows an honest link state.
- **Lightweight installer.** Build-only + frontend-only trees out of the package, Chromium locales en-US only, koffi win32-x64 only: node_modules 141 -> 33MB, Setup 156 -> 130MB, production boot 7.3s -> 2.3s.
- Differential updates keep working (latest.yml + blockmap ship with this release).

## Verified

- tsc clean, 99 agent + 8 character + 32 Python tests green, portable smoke test passed (backend :47130 OK, 84 tools, zero virtual names, emergency stop OK).

**Note:** PC agent bundle rebuilt for this release (84-tool agent, dual-cursor free).

## What's new ??? opencode-style auto-update

The updater is now a hybrid: electron-updater for speed + the custom updater for flexibility.

**New**
- Differential updates: only changed blocks download (latest.yml + .blockmap ship with this release) instead of the full 150MB every time.
- Hash-verified installs: every update is sha512-checked before it touches your PC (previously size-only).
- Silent quit-and-install for the installed build; portable keeps its guided wizard.
- Kept: switch to ANY older version, mirror-feed fallback, and the same update buttons ??? no UI changes.

**Fixed**
- Slow full re-downloads on every update ??? fixed with blockmap differentials.
- Weak size-only download check ??? fixed with sha512 verification.
- Verified: tsc clean, 80 agent + 8 character + 43 Python tests green (incl. differential stage + fallback tests), portable smoke test passed (96 agent tools).

**Note:** PC agent bundle unchanged; installer carries the same 96-tool agent. First release to publish latest.yml ??? differential downloads activate from the NEXT update onward.

Chat/voice/memory UI works; PC control (desktop agent) is Windows-only and stays disabled on Linux. No auto-update for this asset; the Windows feed (releases.json/latest.yml) is unchanged.

## What's new

**Virtual AI cursor OFF switch (Settings → PC control and safety)**
- New toggle **Virtual AI cursor** under *While ABxAG works*. Turn it off and every AI click stays on your physical mouse — guaranteed, enforced in the backend before any agent call.
- OFF hides the red overlay cursor completely; it comes back the moment you re-enable. Pause (Ctrl+Alt+P) always stays available.
- If the AI hits the OFF switch mid-task, it tells you plainly and continues with the physical mouse instead of retrying.

**Auto-update repaired**
- Fixed: on networks where api.github.com 404s, the updater fell back to the mirror feed but parsed it as blank versions with no installers — so it wrongly said *up-to-date* and old versions showed nothing to install. The mirror shape is now parsed properly (all 13 releases show with installers), and unknown feed shapes fail loudly instead of faking *up-to-date*.
- After installing this version once, auto-update and switching to any older version work on their own.

## Fixed
- Virtual cursor could not be turned off at all — fixed with a real kill switch (setting + backend gate + overlay hide).
- Auto-update silent *up-to-date* lie on restricted networks — fixed + regression tests.
- Verified: tsc clean, 78 agent + 8 character + 43 Python tests green, portable smoke test passed (96 agent tools, kill-switch toggled live OFF→ON).

**Note:** PC agent bundle unchanged (no runtime tool change); installer carries the same 96-tool agent.

## What's new — Dual-Cursor actually works now

The virtual (AI) mouse existed in v1.1.12 but never visibly worked. This release wires it end to end:

**New**
- AI knows the virtual pointer: 11 virtual tool declarations for the task engine (virtualMove/Click/RightClick/DoubleClick/Type/Scroll/Inspect/Find/UiAction, pause/resumeVirtual) + a DUAL-CURSOR rule — when you may be at the PC, ABxAG uses the virtual cursor that never touches your physical mouse.
- Live neon AI cursor: the red overlay cursor now follows the AI in real time (1/s backend poll) with an Active/Idle/Paused pill showing its current task.
- Ctrl+Alt+P now really pauses/resumes the AI backend (previously overlay display only).
- New local endpoint GET /api/virtual-cursor with the live virtual-cursor state.
- CI workflow: every push to DEV now runs tsc lint, Electron syntax checks and all 43 Python agent tests automatically.

**Fixed**
- AI always stole the physical mouse (it had no virtual declarations) — fixed, it now prefers background UIA + window-message actions.
- Overlay cursor frozen at (500,400) — fixed, it glides to whatever the AI touches.
- Pause hotkey desync between overlay and backend — fixed.
- Verified: tsc clean, 72 agent + 8 character + 43 Python tests green, portable smoke test (96 agent tools incl. all 12 virtual) passed.

**Note:** PC agent bundle unchanged since v1.1.12 (no runtime tool change), installer carries the same 96-tool agent.
Dual-cursor: the AI gets its own neon on-screen pointer (UIA + background clicks) while your physical mouse stays 100% yours. Pause anytime with Ctrl+Alt+P.
Full companion control: backflip, dance and every stage move on the desktop doll via companionPerform. Outfit tint touches real clothes only.
Per-doll outfit colors: main stage and desktop companion can each keep their own color. Outfit tint now touches real clothes only (skin/face never dyed).
Character autonomy: she performs body moves on request (jump, wave, dance...), changes character by voice or by herself when long idle, and recolors her outfit on request.
Every surface shows ABxAG now: runtime exe re-stamped (no more Electron name/icon in Task Manager and taskbar), icon fallback hardening.
Truly silent auto-update: no more Choose-Options / Install-Location clicks. Portable and dev builds keep the guided installer.
Coughs and breaths no longer stop her mid-sentence: interrupting takes sustained speech now. Plus a Voice setting to turn interruption on/off.
Auto-install countdown after download + re-prompt when a background download finishes. No more silent stuck updates.
Fixes the 'hit a problem and is reloading' crash loop (task results rendered safely + regression test). Every finished task used to crash the UI.

Update checker mirror fallback (works where api.github.com is blocked), update reminder popup with daily repeat + auto-update switch, /download page with bundled release list. Removes leftover dev scratch file.
About links (abxag.absup.dev + mirror) and in-app updates: auto/manual mode plus one-click switch between any versions, old or new.
First public release. Private 3D AI desktop companion for Windows. Bring your own free Gemini API key, import any .pmx/.pmd/.vrm/.glb/.fbx/.obj character.
